# GEOGRAPHY linestrings
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions
#
# What BigQuery's documentation leaves open about linestrings: how ST_GEOGFROMTEXT reads and
# normalizes them, the digits of lengths and distances, and the errors of functions that take
# only a point or only a linestring.

# Spacing, case and longitudes outside [-180, 180], as for points.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(' linestring ( 1 2 ,3 4 ) ')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(190 10, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.1 0.2, 0.30000000000000004 1)')
?>

SELECT ST_X(ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.1 0.2, 0.30000000000000004 1)'), 2))
?>

# Whether a vertex on the geodesic between its neighbors stays.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)'))
?>

# Malformed text and invalid coordinates.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2 3 4)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2,)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 91)')
?>

# Repeated vertices, either the same or within a micrometer.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0, 1 1)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1e-12 0, 1 1)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0, 1 1)'))
?>

# Lines that pass through a point twice: folding back, overlapping, crossing, touching an edge or
# a vertex, and closed lines that are rings or touch themselves.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 10 0, 5 0, 5 4)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 2, 0 2, 2 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0.5 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0, -1 -1)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0, 0 -1)')
?>

# Edges between antipodal points, exactly as S2 takes them and nearly.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-30 0, 150 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 180 0)')
?>

# Lengths, against ST_DISTANCE between the same points, which is measured through the chord.

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-122.35 47.62, 139.69 35.69)'))
?>

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'))
?>

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), TRUE)
?>

# Distances to and between linestrings, including a point on an edge, which S2 computes as a
# few nanometers away.

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 1 1)'))
?>

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -1, 0 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-1 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 0)
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 111196)
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 111195)
?>

# ST_MAXDISTANCE between vertices, as documented, or over edges, which differ where the farthest
# point of an edge is inside it.

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(170 10, -170 10)'))
?>

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'))
?>

# Equality of linestrings whose vertices differ in order or number.

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 0 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
?>

# GeoJSON, which adds vertices to keep planar edges within 10 meters of geodesic ones.

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)'))
?>

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 10)'))
?>

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 10)'))
?>

# Errors of functions that take a single point.

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
?>

SELECT ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
?>

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
?>

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
?>

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
?>

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
?>

# Errors of functions that take a linestring.

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
?>

SELECT ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
?>

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), 1)
?>

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), 3)
?>

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), 0)
?>

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), NULL)
?>

# ST_MAKELINE of empty geographies and arrays, a single point, antipodal and nearly antipodal
# points, points within a micrometer, and a line that folds back.

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(CAST([] AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)])
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)')])
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(-30, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(150, 0))
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0))
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-12, 0))
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0)])
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 2 0)'))
?>
